body: Register row B-31 (docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md): docs/33 lists as Open, never verified on a real phone and not on the board: another app or a call takes audio focus (PB-F15), headphones or Bluetooth disconnect (PB-F16, the proper behaviour is certain: pause), the phone's disk is full (PB-F17), a downloaded file is damaged (PB-F18), the 6-hour signed song address expires after a long pause and it is not known whether the quiet retry fetches a new one (PB-F9), and the server's reason (removed, age check, YouTube busy) never reaches the notice (PB-F10/F11). Put them in the walk as rows. Also B-32: the board marks P1-06 built but the request-id half of its task is missing.
